57:25.text: Indeed We have sent Our Messengers with clear proofs, and revealed with them the Scripture and the Balance
that mankind may keep up justice. And We brought forth iron wherein is mighty power
that mankind may keep up justice. And We brought forth iron wherein is mighty power (in matters of war
), as well as many benefits for mankind, that Allâh may test who it is that will help Him
and His Messengers in the unseen. Verily, Allâh is All-Strong, All-Mighty.

57:26.text: , and placed in their offspring Prophethood and Scripture. And among them there are some who are guided; but many of them are Fâsiqûn

57:27.text: Then, We sent after them Our Messengers, and We sent ‘Îsâ
. And We ordained in the hearts of those who followed him compassion and mercy. But the monasticism which they invented for themselves, We did not prescribe for them, but
only to please Allâh therewith, but they did not observe it with the right observance. So We gave those among them who believed their
reward; but many of them are Fâsiqûn

57:28.text: ! Fear Allâh, and believe in His Messenger
, He will give you a double portion of His Mercy, and He will give you a light by which you shall walk
. And He will forgive you. And Allâh is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

57:29.text: So that the people of the Scripture
may know that they have no power whatsoever over the Grace of Allâh, and that
in His Hand to bestow it on whomsoever He wills. And Allâh is the Owner of Great Bounty.
